body: I agree **edgeware.network **would be quite good choice. Alternatively we could settle for **edgeware.xyz** maybe, but thats lacking soul a bit.

I was part of the discussions and agree that in general Edgeware.Network is a fine 'starter site' for the project.

This is a discussion about domains but it hints at a much larger issue and that is how best to communicate and target Edgeware to investors - aka those who support the price of the network and enable us to continue funding interesting people and projects... which lets be honest is what the network does.

Myself and Ramsey spoke to a well known VC yesterday about Kabocha - and indeed Edgeware, he was honest, direct and to the point which is what we needed.

He has been early in BTC, ETH and Polkadot / Kusama and has a primary interest in on-chain governance and proposal systems.

His general note was "it needs to be much, much simpler". 

To that end, I would suggest we acquire [https://edgeware.fund](https://edgeware.fund) which was available. 

Let's be honest, Edgeware is a fund - a decentralised one, where everyone votes on how to spend EDG and the project retains stake in the projects it advances like Kabocha. 

This is the route we're moving in with Kabocha - we're just iterating the core functions of the fund, optimising for this 'use case', minting new shares in the fund as proposals are made and retaining 'rights', not just tokens in projects from the worlds most inventive creators.

Let's stop trying to be something we're not, and embrace what we are and have been for some while, a collective or creative folk, funding new things. 

A side note, since we're decentralised and leaderless, we can agree to do this here, or we (Decent Partners / Decentration) can develop the proposition as an extension of our work since it's been the primary way we've been communicating the project anyways!

Hey,

I would not consider those in the voting poll as viable options.

We should aim for these:

- edgeware.network
- edgeware.io
- edgeware.com
- edgeware.org
- edgeware.net
all of these are currently owned by an unknown party - .com is est at 70k USD last time I chatted with the seller
